recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if SupplyRequest or SupplyDelivery are reactivated in the active build and their generated/current artifacts no longer preserve repeatable business identifier semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 OO change request asking that affected resource identifier elements not be treated as the resource's unique logical id; for this supply-related partition, the operative resolution changed SupplyDelivery.identifier to an event identifier used across disparate systems and made it repeatable.
initial_application: No FHIR-15090-tagged source commit was found. Git history shows an implicit pre-application commit, 644f2985adbed8f2ededc714a68a832de4689805, that changed SupplyDelivery.identifier in the old spreadsheet source from 0..1 and dispensing-facility wording to 0..* and the requested supply-delivery event identifier wording.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini's active [resources] list does not include supplyrequest or supplydelivery. The residual SupplyDelivery XML retains the requested 0..* event identifier definition, SupplyRequest.identifier uses 0..* business identifier wording, and adjacent Transport XML uses 0..* transport-event identifier wording. A later FHIR-37742/FHIR-37487 source commit changed the SupplyDelivery comment from dispenser to supplier without reintroducing logical-id semantics. Zulip OO block-vote evidence corroborates the Persuasive disposition, and Confluence/Zulip searches found no conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the remaining relevant source already expresses the intended business/external identifier semantics or is outside the current active resource build scope.
